info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Quality Assurance Reviews API
info.description: The Product Quality Assurance Reviews API allows businesses to submit and manage reviews related to their products. This functionality is essential for maintaining high product standards and ensuring customer satisfaction. Typically utilized by product management teams, this API streamlines the process of collecting feedback and assessing product quality. Users can submit detailed reviews, which can then be analyzed for insights into product performance and areas for improvement.
